_doc: Flags/warnings individually verified against source text by a genuine QA read. Matching entries are suppressed (printed as adjudicated) by qa-source-verify.js and validate-batch.js. Matching is exact on billId+kind+token+path (or check+key), so ANY text change that moves or alters the claim re-opens the flag for fresh adjudication. Editorial-language flags are deliberately NOT adjudicated here — they are open style debt. Reasons cite the verification evidence; sums are reproducible via: npm run facts -- --bill <id> --sums
